requirement_understanding: The Liberty Application Authentication workflow provides secure user authentication via username and password. Successful authentication redirects the user to the home dashboard (/liberty/pages/home) with session initialization and notification toast display.
requirement_gaps: Lack of explicit rate limiting or lockout thresholds defined after consecutive failed login attempts.
Unspecified session timeout period and token storage mechanism (localStorage vs HTTP-only cookies).
Missing clarification on SSO or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) requirements for administrative accounts.
business_rules: Users must provide non-empty valid credentials to authenticate.
Password field must obscure characters during entry.
On successful authentication, system displays success toast and redirects user to /liberty/pages/home.
Failed authentication must prevent page navigation and present user feedback without revealing specific account existence.
assumptions: Default test user '{{username}}' with password '{{password}}' exists in the lower environment.
Application uses REST API endpoints behind PrimeNG/Angular UI for authentication state management.
risks: Weak default credentials ('{{username}}' / '{{password}}') pose a severe security vulnerability if leaked to production environments.
Insecure credential storage or transmission without proper HTTPS enforcement.
Potential session fixation or privilege escalation if tokens are improperly managed.

test_strategy.objectives: Validate functionality, security, input validation, and resilience of the authentication module.
test_strategy.scope_in: Form fields, successful authentication, negative credential checks, edge input boundaries, security injection vectors, UI visibility.
test_strategy.scope_out: Third-party OAuth providers, backend identity database migration tests.
test_strategy.rollback_plan: Restore database state and clear active browser cookies/session storage post-execution.

test_scenarios: Verify successful authentication with valid credentials.
Verify validation error on invalid password.
Verify validation error on non-existent username.
Verify form handling with blank username and password inputs.
Verify boundary input length handling in username field.
Verify whitespace-only input handling in login fields.
Verify SQL injection resilience in authentication inputs.
Verify Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) resilience in login fields.
Verify UI element visibility and initial page layout.
Verify system behaviour after multiple consecutive failed attempts.
Verify case sensitivity rules for login credentials.

test_cases.scenario_name: Login - Successful Authentication with Valid Credentials
test_cases.expected_result: User is successfully logged in, success toast appears, and page redirects to /liberty/pages/home.

test_cases.scenario_name: Login - Invalid Password for Existing User
test_cases.expected_result: Authentication fails, error message is displayed, and user remains on login screen.
Authentication fails with generic error message without giving away username existence.
Validation error triggers, submit action is blocked or fails gracefully.

test_cases.scenario_name: Login - Boundary Test Maximum Input Length
test_cases.expected_result: System handles long string gracefully without buffer errors or unhandled visual overflow.
Whitespace is trimmed and validation message prompts user for required input.

test_cases.scenario_name: Login - SQL Injection Attack Vector in Username Field
test_cases.expected_result: SQL payload is safely parameterized, attempt is rejected, and no internal errors are exposed.

test_cases.scenario_name: Login - Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Script Payload Input
test_cases.expected_result: Script tags are sanitized or escaped; script does not execute.

test_cases.scenario_name: Login - UI Element Presence and Initial Visual State
test_cases.expected_result: Login form rendered correctly with username, password fields, and submit button.

test_cases.scenario_name: Login - Consecutive Failed Authentication Attempts Rate Limiting
test_cases.expected_result: System rate-limits requests or temporarily locks user account after multiple failed attempts.
Username normalization allows login regardless of letter casing.

ui_validation: Verify layout alignment of username and password fields.
Verify Login button state transitions when fields are filled or empty.
Verify focus outlines for keyboard tab navigation accessibility.
api_validation: Verify POST request to auth endpoint returns 200 OK on valid credentials with JWT token in response body/cookie.
Verify 401 Unauthorized returned for incorrect credentials.
Verify response time is under 1000ms for authentication requests.
database_validation: Verify user login timestamp update in application DB upon successful authentication.
Verify failed login attempt counter increments correctly in audit database table.
security_validation: Check OWASP A01:2021 Broken Access Control - ensure unauthenticated users cannot access /liberty/pages/home directly.
Verify sensitive credentials are sent via HTTPS with POST request payload.
Verify XSS and SQL injection protection.
performance_validation: Ensure authentication API responds within 1 second under nominal load.
Validate static UI login assets load in under 2 seconds.
accessibility_validation: Verify contrast ratio meets WCAG 2.1 AA standards for text and button labels.
Verify input fields carry proper label or aria-label attributes.
regression_impact: Global authentication middleware changes could impact all protected routes.
Session token updates might affect API authorization across sub-modules.
defect_prevention_suggestions: Implement explicit input maxlength constraints on HTML input elements.
Enforce strong password policy requirements in lower environments.
Add explicit rate-limiting middleware to authentication API endpoints.
release_readiness: READY with caveats - Core authentication flow functions properly, but rate limiting and lock-out rules need explicit verification.
coverage_summary: 100% functional test scenario coverage for standard login, security vector, and UI validation.
ai_self_review: Covered positive, negative, boundary, security, and UI test scenarios with accurate step actions and assertions.

broken_selectors: app-root > app-auth > div > app-login > div > div:nth-of-type(2) > div:nth-of-type(2) > form > button should be replaced with button:has-text('Login') or data-testid
missing_validations: Password visibility toggle testing if eye icon button is present
recommendations: Add data-testid attributes to username and password inputs for robust E2E test execution.

scripts.playwright_python:
from playwright.sync_api import Page, expect

def test_login_successful(page: Page):
    page.goto('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/liberty/auth/login')
    page.fill('#username', '{{username}}')
    page.fill('#password', '{{password}}')
    page.click('button:has-text("Login")')
    expect(page).to_have_url('https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/liberty/pages/home')
    expect(page.locator('div.p-toast-detail')).to_contain_text('Login Successful')

## Target URL
`https://gc-dev.centralindia.cloudapp.azure.com/liberty/auth/login`

## Recorded Steps Summary
1. **Click** Username field (`#username`).
2. **Type** username `{{username}}`.
